outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars despite N=4, n>100 being reported.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of the percentage of aggregate-positive Purkinje cells, but individual data points from the four mice per group are not shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot of rotarod performance over time; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots showing rotarod performance across days; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows micrograph images of cerebellar tissue and is not a plot displaying averaged data.

Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) showing mean ± SD across N=3 mice (n=9 measurements), but no individual data points are overlaid on either bar chart.
